title: Dasakam 66 — Gopījanāhlādanam
description: The gopikas approach Krishna at the moonlit Yamuna; Krishna speaks of dharma, receives their pleas, shares devotional companionship with them, and Bhattathiri closes with a prayer for relief from illness.

source.commentary: intake/D066/photo-captions.txt; raw intake metadata preserved in content/sources/d066/source.json

translation_note: No vetted English stanza translation is present in the supplied source bundle; translation_en is intentionally empty pending editorial review.

stanzas.sanskrit:
उपयातानां सुदृशां
कुसुमायुधबाणपातविवशानाम् ।
अभिवाञ्छितं विधातुं
कृतमतिरपि ता जगाथ वाममिव ॥ ६६-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
upayātānāṃ sudṛśāṃ
kusumāyudhabāṇapātavivaśānām |
abhivāñchitaṃ vidhātuṃ
kṛtamatirapi tā jagātha vāmamiva || 66-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The beautiful eyed gopikas approached Krishna with lot of love. Krishna had decided to fulfill their desire but however initially spoke to them as if He was not in favour.

stanzas.sanskrit:
गगनगतं मुनिनिवहं
श्रावयितुं जगिथ कुलवधूधर्मम् ।
धर्म्यं खलु ते वचनं
कर्म तु नो निर्मलस्य विश्वास्यम् ॥ ६६-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gaganagataṃ muninivahaṃ
śrāvayituṃ jagitha kulavadhūdharmam |
dharmyaṃ khalu te vacanaṃ
karma tu no nirmalasya viśvāsyam || 66-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Sages had assembled in the skies to see the rasaleela. Krishna started to advise the duties of the good family women to the gopikas loudly so that even the assembled divine sages in sky could hear. Bhattathiri at this point reminds that one should follow the words of Bhagwan, which are always in accordance with dharma and not try to practice few of HIS pure minded actions as they cannot always be classified under right or wrong category with our little knowledge.

stanzas.sanskrit:
आकर्ण्य ते प्रतीपां
वाणीमेणीदृशः परं दीनाः ।
मा मा करुणासिन्धो
परित्यजेत्यतिचिरं विलेपुस्ताः ॥ ६६-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ākarṇya te pratīpāṃ
vāṇīmeṇīdṛśaḥ paraṃ dīnāḥ |
mā mā karuṇāsindho
parityajetyaticiraṃ vilepustāḥ || 66-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Hearing Krishna's unfavourable words, Gopikas felt sad and helpless and requested him not to forsake them.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तासां रुदितैर्लपितैः
करुणाकुलमानसो मुरारे त्वम् ।
ताभिः समं प्रवृत्तो
यमुनापुलिनेषु काममभिरन्तुम् ॥ ६६-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāsāṃ ruditairlapitaiḥ
karuṇākulamānaso murāre tvam |
tābhiḥ samaṃ pravṛtto
yamunāpulineṣu kāmamabhirantum || 66-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Hearing their cries, Krishna with great mercy and compassion towards them, indulged HIMSELF in passion with the Gopikas in the moonlit banks of Yamuna.
The banks of river Yamuna looked beautiful in the moonlight. Gopikas offered a seat for Krishna made with their drape and HE sat on it.
Krishna held their hands and spoke sweetly and playfully and embraced them. Gopikas were immensely pleased and happy.

stanzas.sanskrit:
वासोहरणदिने य-
-द्वासोहरणं प्रतिश्रुतं तासाम् ।
तदपि विभो रस-
-विवशस्वान्तानां कान्तसुभ्रुवामदधाः ॥ ६६-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vāsoharaṇadine ya-
-dvāsoharaṇaṃ pratiśrutaṃ tāsām |
tadapi vibho rasa-
-vivaśasvāntānāṃ kāntasubhruvāmadadhāḥ || 66-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: On the day of the stealing of clothes (the removal of the sense of ego), Bhagwan had promised to the Gopikas that HE would fulfilll their desires and thereby made their minds fill with bliss.

stanzas.sanskrit:
कन्दलितघर्मलेशं
कुन्दमृदुस्मेरवक्त्रपाथोजम् ।
नन्दसुत त्वां त्रिजग-
-त्सुन्दरमुपगूह्य नन्दिता बालाः ॥ ६६-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kandalitagharmaleśaṃ
kundamṛdusmeravaktrapāthojam |
nandasuta tvāṃ trijaga-
-tsundaramupagūhya nanditā bālāḥ || 66-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Perspiration drops sprouted on Bhagwan’s body. Bhagwan’s lotus face was soft with a jasmine like smile. The Gopikas were carried away to an ecstatic world with Krishna's ever enchanting smile.

stanzas.sanskrit:
विरहेष्वङ्गारमयः
शृङ्गारमयश्च सङ्गमेऽपि त्वम् ।
नितरामङ्गारमय-
-स्तत्र पुनः सङ्गमेऽपि चित्रमिदम् ॥ ६६-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
viraheṣvaṅgāramayaḥ
śṛṅgāramayaśca saṅgame’pi tvam |
nitarāmaṅgāramaya-
-statra punaḥ saṅgame’pi citramidam || 66-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: When one gets separated from Krishna, it causes unbearable pain to the heart. When one is with HIM, Krishna is an absolute embodiment of love. When in union with HIM like these Gopikas, they reach a state of extreme delight and bliss.

stanzas.sanskrit:
राधातुङ्गपयोधर-
-साधुपरीरम्भलोलुपात्मानम् ।
आराधये भवन्तं
पवनपुराधीश शमय सकलगदान् ॥ ६६-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
rādhātuṅgapayodhara-
-sādhuparīrambhalolupātmānam |
ārādhaye bhavantaṃ
pavanapurādhīśa śamaya sakalagadān || 66-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri prays to Bhagwan Guruvayoorappa to eradicate his ailments.
